I would like to share my experience in journey to business FOREX. This is not a game, by studying the material on this website you can get your real business. I began my journey about 4.5 years ago. Purely by chance, having learned from the Internet, I decided to try it. I visited one-month free courses in my city, but with the obligatory opening of Live account in the broker's club. After the course I opened the account with $ 2,000 on it. As I understand how, I was lucky because a month later I returned $ 2700. It became even more interesting, I realized that I can make money fast and even faster. Two months later, I already had $ 500 on my account, and I stopped trading, knowing that something was missed. My first cognition was the study of indicators. Within 1 year I reviewed 1000 indicators, changed their parameters, and finally I realized that everything was useless and I just spent a year out of window. I didn't trade for almost a year, so I did not spend my deposit. Then I accidentally (though nothing happens by chance) came across a book "Trading Chaos" by Bill Williams. I studied the theory, practice, and I realized that since then I was ready to trade successfully. I do not want to criticize this theory and Bill Williams, on many sites is it written that this strategy made his family multimillionaire, but I had no luck, unfortunately or fortunately, but I wasted my deposit. At that moment I gave up Trading for three months and, honestly, I was ready to forget about the case. Once on the Internet, since the 21 century is a century of the Internet, I ran against an article about the schedule and Elliott wave analysis. I was very inspired and found immediately the books on Wave Analysis, no need to list them here as those, who were fond of the Wave Analysis, know these books well. You know, I was lucky, my second deposit began to grow, and for 6 months I was a profitable trader. I was happy https://www.readthemarket.com/index.php/en/forum/journals/2042-alex-s-journal?start=475 22/30 7/27/2018 Alex`s journal - Page 20 - RTM Community more then ever. At first I did not take it seriously, but then I felt uneasy, when the wave analysis began to falter in my analysis. Each proved his case, so did I, and, as it seemed to me, each got a point. I ended in a deadlock... I started to make mistakes, and almost spent second deposit. I realized that although Wave Analysis is really good kind of analysis, I'm probably out of luck. So, 3 years passed. A friend of mine advised me a well-known site FF, and I got to the Thread J16. I was inspired again, studied, dug and delved. I liked the understanding of the market, but I was not mentally ready to trade, even though I really liked the thread J16 and still like it. I wanted to get something easy that can be fun to use. I remember, when as a child I attended a club of martial arts and the coach said: you need to learn and hone one hold so that you like it and feel yourself the best in it. And then you can learn more advanced techniques, i.e., step by step, and never in a hurry. The comfort will come, but only with practice. I remember these words, which often help me in life - step by step, without a rush. Purely by chance I met IF on the site FF, and I began to read his thread (read the market). So, I came to the site RTM. Having experience, even segmental, for 2-3 months I swallowed as a machine the journals of Traders ... I was so engrossed that I started and ended the day with RTM. It seems intuitively I knew that there I would find what I was looking for. Then I took a break for two weeks, I did not want to get used to it. Then I started doing homework, as advised on the site. After about 5 months I finally realized that I had found what I was looking for. And I found the following: All the beauty of the market can be read only in terms of pure chart and without any indicators, pure chart only. A thought flashed - it is the same like the doctor reads cardiogram. He can determine the problems with heart, using simple diagram. It takes about six months to learn the material on this site. I wrote �Beauty is in the simplicity� at the bottom of my nickname, for the reason that I like to find the simple things that work. I couldn't help but revisit this old trade you took. Whether price breaking a FL or FTR results in an engulf vs. a fakeout can be difficult to determine. I've seen advanced traders here on RTM who sometimes get it wrong. Do you purposefully wait for a possible engulf to occur, and watch to see how price interacts with the origin of that possible engulf? If price also breaks the DP/source FL of the original engulf, can you be more sure that the initial move you originally assumed was an engulf, is instead a fakeout? Adopting this strategy would mean many traders end up missing out on the opportunity to successfully trade the original 'possible' engulf, however I wonder if being patient and waiting for this confirmation drastically increases the odds of a profitable trade...not to mention it forms a basic QM. I do not want to criticize this theory and Bill Williams, on many sites is it written that this strategy made his family multimillionaire, but I had no luck, unfortunately or fortunately, but I wasted my deposit. I couldn't help but revisit this old trade you took. Whether price breaking a FL or FTR results in an engulf vs. a fakeout can be difficult to determine. I've seen advanced traders here on RTM who sometimes get it wrong. Do you purposefully wait for a possible engulf to occur, and watch to see how price interacts with the origin of that possible engulf? If price also breaks the DP/source FL of the original engulf, can you be more sure that the initial move you originally assumed was an engulf, is instead a fakeout? Adopting this strategy would mean many traders end up missing out on the opportunity to successfully trade the original 'possible' engulf, however I wonder if being patient and waiting for this confirmation drastically increases the odds of a profitable trade...not to mention it forms a basic QM. I would like to share my experience in journey to business FOREX. This is not a game, by studying the material on this website you can get your real business. I began my journey about 4.5 years ago. Purely by chance, having learned from the Internet, I decided to try it. I visited one-month free courses in my city, but with the obligatory opening of Live account in the broker's club. After the course I opened the account with $ 2,000 on it. As I understand how, I was lucky because a month later I returned $ 2700. It became even more interesting, I realized that I can make money fast and even faster. Two months later, I already had $ 500 on my account, and I stopped trading, knowing that something was missed. My first cognition was the study of indicators. Within 1 year I reviewed 1000 indicators, changed their parameters, and finally I realized that everything was useless and I just spent a year out of window. I didn't trade for almost a year, so I did not spend my deposit. Then I accidentally (though nothing happens by chance) came across a book "Trading Chaos" by Bill Williams. I studied the theory, practice, and I realized that since then I was ready to trade successfully. I do not want to criticize this theory and Bill Williams, on many sites is it written that this strategy made his family multimillionaire, but I had no luck, unfortunately or fortunately, but I wasted my deposit. At that moment I gave up Trading for three months and, honestly, I was ready to forget about the case. Once on the Internet, since the 21 century is a century of the Internet, I ran against an article about the schedule and Elliott wave analysis. I was very inspired and found immediately the books on Wave Analysis, no need to list them here as those, who were fond of the Wave Analysis, know these books well. You know, I was lucky, my second deposit began to grow, and for 6 months I was a profitable trader. I was happy https://www.readthemarket.com/index.php/en/forum/journals/2042-alex-s-journal?start=475 22/30 7/27/2018 Alex`s journal - Page 20 - RTM Community more then ever. I participated at the forums on wave analysis, I began to notice that five HOME EDUCATION FORUM MORE LOGOUT Wavers have 5 different versions of market analysis for wave analysis. At first I did not take it seriously, but then I felt uneasy, when the wave analysis began to falter in my analysis. Each proved his case, so did I, and, as it seemed to me, each got a point. I ended in a deadlock... I started to make mistakes, and almost spent second deposit. I realized that although Wave Analysis is really good kind of analysis, I'm probably out of luck. So, 3 years passed. A friend of mine advised me a well-known site FF, and I got to the Thread J16. I was inspired again, studied, dug and delved. I liked the understanding of the market, but I was not mentally ready to trade, even though I really liked the thread J16 and still like it. I wanted to get something easy that can be fun to use. I remember, when as a child I attended a club of martial arts and the coach said: you need to learn and hone one hold so that you like it and feel yourself the best in it. And then you can learn more advanced techniques, i.e., step by step, and never in a hurry. The comfort will come, but only with practice. I remember these words, which often help me in life - step by step, without a rush. Purely by chance I met IF on the site FF, and I began to read his thread (read the market). So, I came to the site RTM. Having experience, even segmental, for 2-3 months I swallowed as a machine the journals of Traders ... I was so engrossed that I started and ended the day with RTM. It seems intuitively I knew that there I would find what I was looking for. Then I took a break for two weeks, I did not want to get used to it. Then I started doing homework, as advised on the site. After about 5 months I finally realized that I had found what I was looking for. And I found the following: All the beauty of the market can be read only in terms of pure chart and without any indicators, pure chart only. A thought flashed - it is the same like the doctor reads cardiogram. He can determine the problems with heart, using simple diagram. It takes about six months to learn the material on this site. I wrote �Beauty is in the simplicity� at the bottom of my nickname, for the reason that I like to find the simple things that work. I really liked the last posts of Benhur, which confirmed that I am on the right way: look for simple things on the market - this is the https://www.readthemarket.com/index.php/en/forum/journals/2042-alex-s-journal?start=475 23/30 7/27/2018 Alex`s journal - Page 20 - RTM Community main. And you know, in order to get PATIENCE - you should not wait or demand anything from the market, don't wait that the market goes towards you. Just hone simple things and use them. It is very important to create your own journal and put charts in order to improve your skills . Just wanted to share my experience. Today I'm looking for simple things, and you can see from my posts that I am using the simple things, and they work. Today I am a profitable trader. I do not demand from the market ANYTHING, I just like to look at the chart and have fun as PRO makes money. And one more thing: do not put the goal of making money instantly. Let the grass grows by itself without your efforts. I hope you understand me. Beauty is in simplicity. Many thanks to IF and team of Masters-Traders for creating an excellent communication here. I couldn't help but revisit this old trade you took. Whether price breaking a FL or FTR results in an engulf vs. a fakeout can be difficult to determine. I've seen advanced traders here on RTM who sometimes get it wrong. Do you purposefully wait for a possible engulf to occur, and watch to see how price interacts with the origin of that possible engulf? If price also breaks the DP/source FL of the original engulf, can you be more sure that the initial move you originally assumed was an engulf, is instead a fakeout? Adopting this strategy would mean many traders end up missing out on the opportunity to successfully trade the original 'possible' engulf, however I wonder if being patient and waiting for this confirmation drastically increases the odds of a profitable trade...not to mention it forms a basic QM.
